sentences.en: Paying the national debt could mean reducing the average income.
sentences.zh: 偿还国家债务可能意味着降低平均收入。

sentences.en: After doing quality work, his average has gone up marvellously.
sentences.zh: 经过一段时间出色的工作后，他的平均水平大幅提升。

sentences.en: She reads on average three or four books a week.
sentences.zh: 她每周平均读三到四本书。
